item.title: Best Of Hugh Hewitt - 1360 KHNC
item.description: So it’s no easy task to wake up an entire nation, but Hugh Hewitt is a broadcast pro who does it with ease. He is America’s true East Coast-West Coast man, doing the show most of the time from inside the Beltway of Washington DC, but other times from his studio in Southern California, where Hugh is a professor of law at Chapman University’s Fowler School of Law, teaching Constitutional Law.

item.description: An insightful and provocative documentary on the life and death of William Cooper, author of the classic conspiracy book 'Behold a Pale Horse,' and host of the popular 1990's cult short-wave radio programme 'The Hour of Our Time.'
